title: Act: Export palette Tailwind colours and register them in tailwind.config.ts
description: Derive the Tailwind colour object from PALETTE_RAMPS and add it to the Tailwind theme.
acceptance_criteria: paletteTailwindColors maps ramp -> step number -> hex.
tailwind.config.ts theme.extend.colors.pal equals it and old tokens remain.

preserve: Existing hsl tokens, content globs, plugins

technical_constraints: Tailwind stays; derive from the single palette, do not copy hex values.

steps.action: Export paletteTailwindColors built from PALETTE_RAMPS: each ramp name maps to an object whose keys are '1'..'6' and values are the hex.
Import paletteTailwindColors from './src/lib/palette' after line 2 and add pal: paletteTailwindColors inside theme.extend.colors next to muted and border, leaving other keys unchanged.
steps.code:
import { paletteTailwindColors } from './src/lib/palette';
... muted:'hsl(var(--muted))', border:'hsl(var(--border))', pal: paletteTailwindColors }
steps.expected: theme.extend.colors.pal is defined; background is still hsl(var(--background)).
